note: Hunted-and-verified links for every rendered ballot candidate (session 2026-08-13, item 2b). Every URL in `links` was fetched this session and the page read to confirm it names the person and the race or office; the `verification` sentence records what was seen. Official pages read from a legislature's server-rendered member roster carry that chain in the sentence. `hunts` records every candidate for whom no link ships: MISS means a search was run and nothing verifiable was found; NOT_ATTEMPTED means the hunt is queued and no claim of absence is made. gc.nh.gov member pages cannot be verified from this pipeline (TLS wall, docs/source-ladder.md) and are recorded in hunts rather than shipped unverified.
